answer:
The Household expenses page now shows only Food and Housing. The total, the colour bar, the category list, the "Latest" entries and the category dropdown in the add form all use just those two categories.

I also fixed a bug. The page didn't recognise your "Amt" column as the amount, so it wasn't totalling correctly. It does now.

Your note's table still has the Bills and Health rows. I only changed how the page displays them.

The tool also warned that the input fields on the page have no labels, which VoiceOver needs. I didn't change that.
